rule_name: WPCrack -> Privilege Escalation -> (Root Access / DNS Exfiltration)

tree.name: Phát hiện WPCrack
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WHERE http.is_scanner = true OR http.uri CONTAINS 'wp-login.php' WITH ip, max(datetime(req.last_seen)) AS time_wpcrack RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, toString(time_wpcrack) AS time_wpcrack LIMIT 1

on_match.alert_message: ⚠️ [LOW] Phát hiện IP {attacker_ip} đang brute-force wp-login lúc {time_wpcrack}

next.name: Chuyển tài khoản trái phép bằng su
next.query: MATCH (u:User {username: 'www-data'})-[su:RAN_AS {is_su: true}]->(p:Process) WHERE datetime(su.last_seen) >= datetime($time_wpcrack) AND duration.inSeconds(datetime($time_wpcrack), datetime(su.last_seen)).hours <= 2 RETURN u.username AS original_user, su.target_user AS compromised_user, toString(max(datetime(su.last_seen))) AS time_su

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [MEDIUM] Tài khoản Web {original_user} đã leo quyền thành {compromised_user} lúc {time_su}!

next.name: Lạm dụng Sudo
next.query: MATCH (u:User {username: $compromised_user})-[sudo:RAN_AS {is_sudo: true}]->(p:Process) WHERE datetime(sudo.last_seen) >= datetime($time_su) RETURN sudo.command AS root_command

next.name: Tuồn dữ liệu qua DNS
next.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[q:QUERIED]->(dns:DNSQuery) WHERE size(dns.rrname) > 40 AND datetime(q.last_seen) >= datetime($time_su) WITH ip, count(q) AS dns_count WHERE dns_count > 5 RETURN ip.ip AS exfil_ip, dns_count

on_match.alert_message: 💥 [HIGH] Máy chủ {exfil_ip} đang tuồn {dns_count} gói dữ liệu mật qua DNS Tunneling!
